title: Isolated Zr Surface Sites on Silica Promote Hydrogenation of CO2 to CH3OH in Supported Cu Catalysts

extraction_notes: Only main-text catalytic performance figure is Figure 3. Figures 1, 2, 4, and 5 are schematic/characterization/NMR/XAS and were not extracted. All plotted numerical values are approximate visual digitizations from the page image and marked with qualifier '~'. Figure 3b,c x-axis is contact time, read as h g mL-1 from the figure; the schema has no dedicated contact-time field, so the x-axis value is recorded in entry_label and notes. CO formation rates in Figure 3a,c are captured in notes because the schema has no separate field for CO formation rate.
